title: Tier Schedule Entry
description: Entry in the Tier Schedule of an account

tier_name.description: Name of a tier contained in the credit product. Mutually exclusive with tier_rates

effective_date.description: Date the tier should be effective in YYYY-MM-DD format

tier_rates.description: Custom rates per category.  Mutually exclusive with tier_name

penalty_rates.description: Custom rates per category for penalties

credit_product_token.description: Globally unique identifier for a credit product
